text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All right!
Today's leg presses are doooone!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: After giving muscle training everything I've got... it just makes me wanna work out even more!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hey, don't you think so too?!

Suddenly, my agreement was sought.
Now then, how should I answer――
choice_data_list: I know, right! I want to go all the way!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Right?!
Once you're completely worn out, that's when the real fun starts~

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: All right, extra leg presses! 10 sets! Let's blow right past my limits!

Beaming with a bright smile,
Winning Ticket threw herself back into training...

Winning Ticket's grit and stamina
are truly impressive.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, really?! You sure?
Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Still, why are you giving it to me?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right! Gotcha!
All right, I'm gonna go rest with everything I've got!

...She left without taking her drink.
Still, when it's time to rest, give it everything you've got.
Knowing when to switch gears is vital.
